svg.title: Project 13 finished, on tan skin: a big purple flower on the shoulder cap with a soft purple glow, a green vine with leaves along the collarbone that ends in a curl before the center line, a second vine that spirals down the upper arm and forearm, leaving one edge and coming back on the other, two small magenta flowers on the vine, a leaf bracelet at the wrist, thin black outlines, white highlights and white dot trails. A gray-blue top covers the chest.
